related_issues.reason: Same ignore-until-fixed setting; asks that ignores be removed automatically once a fix is available (prune/update behaviour). Related follow-up, not the same request as a wildcard ALL value.
uv audit ignore handling (--ignore and --ignore-until-fixed); proposes a VEX file for explicit ignores. Same area, different request.
Roadmap/tracking issue for uv audit. Context for the feature area, not a duplicate.
Filtering uv audit results (direct-only). Same area, different filter request.

rationale: The reporter asks for a magic ALL value for the ignore-until-fixed setting so that uv audit reports only packages with CVEs that already have upstream fixes. uv works as designed here, and the request is for new behaviour, so this is an enhancement. The existing ignore-until-fixed setting already covers the workaround per package, which matches the reporter's own description. No duplicate found: searches for a wildcard or ALL ignore turned up nothing. #19265 is the closest, but it covers auto-removal of stale ignores, not wildcard selection. The issue body says 'ruff audit' and 'ruff check' in places, which looks like a copy error from another project; it does not change the triage. Reporter's template label (enhancement) matches.
